newsitem.title: USA: Florida Panthers to close on Boca club.
newsitem.headline: Florida Panthers to close on Boca club.

text.p: Florida Panthers Holdings Inc said Thursday its acquisition of the Boca Raton Resort and Club LP should close shortly. It said the Securities and Exchange Commission has declared effective its registration statement for the acquisition.
The Boca Raton Resort and Club in Boca Raton, Florida, includes more than one thousand rooms plus golf, tennis and other sports amenities and a full service marina.

"The addition of the Boca Raton Resort and Club brings into our company one of the crown jewels in the hospitality industry," Florida Panthers Chairman H. Wayne Huizenga said in a statement. "We will continue to explore other opportunities in luxury resorts and club properties."
